key_idea: Sum the series with a running term t /= (i+1); terms vanish after ~25 iterations.
sketch: Accumulate 1/i! incrementally in long double, never computing factorials explicitly (they overflow), and stop early once the term is below 1e-30 so n=10000 is no issue. Print with 15 decimals to satisfy the 1e-12 tolerance. O(min(n,30)).
